notes.title: Important Update Regarding 《Greatsword Arena》 Release Strategy
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,[/p][p align="start"]Thank you for your ongoing interest and support for 《Greatsword Arena》。 We have an important update to share regarding our release plans.[/p][p align="start"]After careful consideration, we have decided [b]to no longer create two separate Steam store pages (a free Demo and a paid Full Version)[/b] for 《Greatsword Arena》。 Instead, both will be available under a single store page.[/p][p align="start"]What this means:[/p][olist][*][p]The [b]main game will become a paid title[/b]. Purchasing it will grant access to the complete full version with all content.[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]completely free Demo will be permanently available[/b]! You will be able to find and download it directly from the store page. This Demo contains early game content, allowing you to experience the core gameplay and help us gather valuable feedback. We highly encourage everyone to try it out and join the discussion![/p][/*][/olist][p align="start"]
[b]We're excited to share that the free Demo is currently in full swing and progressing well! We are targeting to release it ahead of the Steam October Next Fest, aiming to provide a stable and content-rich version for everyone to enjoy during the festival. We can't wait to share it with you all![/b][/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Why this change?[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Unified Community[/b]: We want all players – whether trying the Demo or owning the full game – to gather in one central hub for discussions and sharing, fostering a stronger and more vibrant community.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Simplified Experience[/b]: A single store page provides a clearer overview of the game for new players, reduces confusion, and makes the process of trying the Demo or purchasing the game more straightforward.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]For existing followers and players[/b]
Your support means everything to us. This change [b]does not affect your access to the free Demo[/b]. We sincerely hope you enjoy the Demo and will consider joining us for the complete adventure when the full version launches.[/p][p align="start"]Thank you again for your understanding and support. Get ready for the Demo this October Next Fest, and stay tuned for more updates![/p][p align="start"]Best regards,
The 《Greatsword Arena》 Development Team[/p]
